tables.description: Flat table of XBRL fact observations from SEC EDGAR Company Facts API. One row per company per concept per unit per reporting period per filing. Flattened from the deeply nested SEC EDGAR JSON structure.
tables.row_grain: One fact observation: a single reported value for a specific XBRL concept, in a specific unit, for a specific reporting period, from a specific SEC filing.

fields.definition: SEC Central Index Key — unique numeric identifier assigned to every entity that files with the SEC. Used to join across all SEC data.
Official company name as registered with the SEC. May use all-caps or formal legal name (e.g., 'MICROSOFT CORPORATION' instead of 'Microsoft Corp.').

XBRL taxonomy the concept belongs to. Most common: 'us-gaap' (US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), 'dei' (Document and Entity Information), 'ifrs-full' (International Financial Reporting Standards).
fields.source: SEC EDGAR API — key name under .facts object

fields.definition: XBRL concept name — the specific financial metric being reported. Examples: 'Revenue', 'Assets', 'EarningsPerShareBasic'. These are the standardized tag names from the XBRL taxonomy.
fields.source: SEC EDGAR API — key name under taxonomy object

fields.definition: Human-readable label for the concept, provided by the XBRL taxonomy. More readable than the concept name (e.g., 'Earnings Per Share, Basic' instead of 'EarningsPerShareBasic').
Longer description of what the concept represents, from the XBRL taxonomy. May be absent for some concepts.
Unit of measurement for the fact value. Examples: 'USD' (US dollars), 'shares' (share count), 'USD/shares' (per-share dollar amounts like EPS).
fields.source: SEC EDGAR API — key name under .units object

fields.definition: Start of the reporting period. Present for duration facts (income statement, cash flow). Null for point-in-time (instant) facts like balance sheet items.
End of the reporting period. Always present. For instant facts (balance sheet), this is the measurement date. For duration facts, this is the period end.
The reported fact value. Can be zero (e.g., no goodwill impairment) or negative (e.g., net loss). Stored as double to accommodate integers (revenue), fractions (EPS), and ratios.
SEC accession number — uniquely identifies the specific SEC filing this fact came from. Format: XXXXXXXXXX-YY-ZZZZZZ. Multiple facts share an accession number when they come from the same filing.
The fiscal year the filing covers (e.g., 2023). Note: fiscal years may not align with calendar years for all companies.
The fiscal period within the year. Common values: 'FY' (full year), 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4' (quarters).
SEC form type. Common values: '10-K' (annual report), '10-Q' (quarterly report), '8-K' (current report), '10-K/A' and '10-Q/A' (amendments).
Date the filing was officially submitted to the SEC. Critical for amendment detection — later filed_date with same concept and period indicates a potential amendment.
XBRL frame identifier used by SEC for frame-based queries. Format examples: 'CY2023' (calendar year), 'CY2023Q1I' (Q1 instant). Frequently absent.
UTC timestamp when this row was written to the raw zone by the ingest pipeline. Used for pipeline auditing and debugging.
The URL the raw JSON data was fetched from. For API method, the per-company endpoint URL. For bulk_zip method, the ZIP download URL.
How the data was obtained. Either 'api' (per-company API endpoint) or 'bulk_zip' (extracted from bulk companyfacts.zip download).

tables.description: Canonical mapping from SEC EDGAR CIK to normalized company identity. Each row is a resolved entity with confidence score, resolution method, and approval status.
tables.row_grain: One resolved entity: a canonical company identity mapped from a SEC EDGAR CIK.

fields.definition: Stable identifier (ER-NNN). Primary key.
SEC Central Index Key.
Normalized company display name.
Entity name as received from SEC EDGAR.
Primary stock ticker symbol.
Standard Industrial Classification code.
Fiscal year end in MMDD format.
Resolution confidence (0.0-1.0).
Method: exact_cik_match or fuzzy_name_normalize.
Approval status (approved).
Agent that proposed this mapping.
Who approved: human:jeff or auto.
UTC timestamp when proposed.
UTC timestamp when approved.

tables.description: Audit trail for every entity resolution decision. Immutable append-only log.
tables.row_grain: One audit event on an entity mapping.

fields.definition: UUID primary key.
FK to entity_mappings.
Action: proposed, approved, rejected, updated.
Who performed: @entity-resolver, human:jeff, auto.
Why this action was taken.
JSON string with supporting data.
Confidence at time of action.
UTC timestamp of action.

tables.description: Mapping from us-gaap XBRL concept names to canonical business terms. One row per distinct concept. Covers all 3,285 us-gaap concepts with tiered classification: Tier 1 (exact match), Tier 2 (prefix/pattern), Tier 3 (unmapped).
tables.row_grain: One distinct us-gaap XBRL concept with its canonical business term mapping (or null if unmapped).

fields.definition: Stable identifier (TN-NNNN). Primary key. Assigned alphabetically by concept.
Raw us-gaap XBRL concept name as received from SEC EDGAR.
Human-readable name of the mapped business term. Null for unmapped (Tier 3) concepts.
Business glossary reference (BT-024 through BT-048). Null for unmapped.
Primary financial statement: balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow, per_share, other.
Specific grouping within financial statement (e.g., revenue, assets, eps, tax).
Classification tier: 1 (exact match), 2 (prefix/pattern match), 3 (unmapped).
Mapping confidence: 1.0 (exact), 0.7 (prefix), 0.6 (pattern), 0.0 (unmapped).
How the mapping was determined: exact_match, prefix_match, pattern_match, unmapped.
Approval status: approved (tier 1+2 after gate), unmapped (tier 3), pending, rejected.
Agent that proposed this mapping (@tag-normalizer).
UTC timestamp when mapping was proposed.

tables.description: Audit trail for every tag normalization decision. Immutable append-only log. Same 8-field schema as entity_resolution_audit.
tables.row_grain: One audit event on a concept mapping.

fields.definition: UUID primary key.
FK to concept_mappings.mapping_id.
Action: proposed, approved, rejected, classified_unmapped.
Who performed: @tag-normalizer, human:jeff, auto.
Why this action was taken.
JSON string with supporting data (concept, fact_count, company_count).
Confidence at time of action.
UTC timestamp of action.

tables.description: Central fact table joining raw XBRL facts with entity_mappings (company metadata) and concept_mappings (business term/tier classification). Denormalized for query convenience. Grain includes accession_number to preserve all filing versions including amendments.
tables.row_grain: One XBRL fact observation enriched with entity and concept metadata, identified by (cik, concept, unit, start_date, end_date, accession_number).

fields.definition: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of grain fields (cik, concept, unit, start_date, end_date, accession_number), truncated to 16 chars. Primary key.
FK to entity_mappings.mapping_id. Denormalized from entity resolution.
SEC Central Index Key from raw zone.
Normalized company name from entity_mappings.
Stock ticker from entity_mappings.
XBRL concept name from raw zone.
Business glossary reference from concept_mappings. Null for tier 3 unmapped concepts.
Human-readable business term name from concept_mappings. Null for tier 3.
Primary financial statement from concept_mappings: balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow, per_share, other.
Category within financial statement from concept_mappings (e.g., revenue, assets, eps).
Classification tier from concept_mappings: 1 (exact), 2 (prefix/pattern), 3 (unmapped).
XBRL taxonomy from raw zone (us-gaap, dei, invest, srt).
Unit of measurement from raw zone (USD, shares, USD/shares).
Reported fact value from raw zone.
Reporting period start from raw zone. Null for instant (balance sheet) facts.
Reporting period end from raw zone. Always present.
Fiscal year from raw zone.
Fiscal period from raw zone (FY, Q1-Q4).
Fiscal year end in MMDD format from entity_mappings.
Calendar year derived from end_date.year.
Calendar quarter (1-4) derived from end_date month.
SEC accession number from raw zone. Part of grain — preserves all filing versions.
SEC form type from raw zone (10-K, 10-Q, 10-K/A, etc.).
Filing date from raw zone. Used for supersession detection.
True if form ends with '/A' (e.g., 10-K/A, 10-Q/A). Derived field.
True if a later filing exists for the same grain (cik, concept, unit, start_date, end_date). Derived field.
Accession number of the superseding (latest) filing. Null if not superseded.
UTC timestamp when this fact was written to the base zone.

tables.description: Fiscal calendar dimension for cross-company temporal alignment. One row per company per fiscal year per fiscal period. Built from observed period boundaries in raw filings.
tables.row_grain: One fiscal period for one company: (cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period).

fields.definition: Deterministic hash of (cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). Primary key.
SEC Central Index Key.
FK to entity_mappings.mapping_id.
Fiscal year (e.g., 2024).
Fiscal period: FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.
Fiscal year end in MMDD format from entity_mappings.
Earliest start_date observed for this period. Null if all facts are instant (no start_date).
Latest end_date observed for this period.
Calendar year of period_end.
Calendar quarter (1-4) of period_end.
Number of days in the period (period_end - period_start). Null if period_start is null.
True if fiscal_period is 'FY'.

tables.description: Supersession audit trail pairing original filings with their amendments. Captures value changes for each superseded fact.
tables.row_grain: One supersession pair: an original filing superseded by a later filing for the same fact grain.

fields.definition: UUID primary key.
SEC Central Index Key.
XBRL concept that was amended.
Measurement unit for the amended value.
Period start of the amended fact.
Period end of the amended fact.
Accession number of the original (superseded) filing.
Filing date of the original.
Value reported in the original filing.
Accession number of the superseding (amendment) filing.
Filing date of the amendment.
Value reported in the amendment filing.
amendment_val - original_val.
Percentage change: (val_change / abs(original_val)) * 100. Null if original_val is 0.
Form type of the amendment (e.g., 10-K/A, 10-Q/A).
UTC timestamp when this supersession was detected.

tables.description: Cross-company financial comparison table. One row per (company, business term, fiscal year, fiscal period). Filters base.financial_facts to current facts with mapped business terms, resolves concept collisions via primary concept preference, and denormalizes company/business term metadata for direct querying.
tables.row_grain: One financial metric value for one company in one fiscal period: (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period).

fields.definition: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of grain fields (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period), truncated to 16 chars. Primary key.
SEC Central Index Key from base.financial_facts.
FK to entity_mappings.mapping_id. Denormalized from base.financial_facts.
Primary stock ticker symbol from base.financial_facts.
Normalized company name from base.financial_facts.

Human-readable sector derived from SIC code via static SIC_TO_SECTOR mapping. One of: Technology, Financials, Healthcare, Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary, Energy, Industrials, Communication Services.
Business glossary reference (BT-022 through BT-048). Identifies the canonical financial metric.
Human-readable business term name (e.g., Revenue, Net Income, Total Assets).
Primary financial statement: balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow, per_share, other.
Category within financial statement (e.g., revenue, assets, eps, tax).
The financial value from the selected source concept after collision resolution. Never null.
Unit of measurement: USD for dollar amounts, USD/shares for per-share metrics. Filtered to primary unit per business term.
The XBRL concept selected by collision resolution. Audit trail showing which concept provided the val.
Fiscal year of the reporting period (e.g., 2023). May differ from calendar year.
Fiscal period: FY (full year), Q1, Q2, Q3.
Fiscal year end in MMDD format from entity_mappings (e.g., 0930 for Apple's September year-end).
End date of the reporting period from base.financial_facts.end_date.
Calendar year of period_end_date. Enables cross-company temporal alignment regardless of fiscal year.
Calendar quarter (1-4) of period_end_date.
SEC accession number of the source filing that provided the selected value.
Date the source filing was submitted to the SEC.
Count of distinct companies with this business term in this fiscal_period type. Enables immediate coverage assessment.
UTC timestamp when this row was written to the consumable zone.
System date when the row was produced. Used for pipeline auditing.
